newsitem.title: USA: NASD elects ex-senator, Goldman CEO to its board.
newsitem.headline: NASD elects ex-senator, Goldman CEO to its board.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers said Wednesday former U.S. Senator from Kansas Nancy Kassebaum Baker has been elected to its board.
Also elected to the board was Goldman, Sachs & Co chairman and chief executive officer Jon Corzine, it said.
Kassebaum served in the U.S. Senate from December 1978 to January 1997.
Corzine joined Goldman Sachs in 1975 and assumed his current position in 1994.
NASD is the securities industry's self-regulatory organization. It operates as subsidiaries the Nasdaq stock market and NASD Regulation Inc, which oversees the brokerage industry.
